description: Start a 3D generation and return its job id at once. mode picks the input: text (prompt), image (options with the image URL), multiview (several view images), sketch, or model (edit an existing 3D model). Take the model id and its option names from list_models, and check the price with estimate_cost first: this spends credits. Pass a stable idempotency_key when retrying so a retry replays the same job instead of billing twice. Then call get_job to follow it.

expected_credits.description: The credits estimate_cost answered for this request. If the price has moved since, nothing is started or charged and the error (price_changed) gives the new price.

idempotency_key.description: Reuse the same value when retrying this exact request.

mode.description: Which input the model is given.

options.description: Model-specific options; take the field names from list_models with include_inputs, and price them with estimate_cost first.

name: generate_3d

deduped.description: True when an earlier call with the same idempotency key already started this job: nothing was charged again.

job_id.description: Pass to get_job to follow progress.

outputs.description: How many results this job makes.

status.description: pending and processing are running; success, partial, failed and canceled are final. 'partial' means some outputs finished and the rest were refunded.

title: Generate a 3D model
